theorems.statement: (∀ (n ℓ p : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (θ : Rn (n + ℓ) → ℝ) (f : Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn p) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn (n + ℓ)), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight n M θ → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ V → ψ u ∈ M → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (ψ u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap) ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)) → ∀ (m k ℓ : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (m + k + ℓ))) (θ : Rn (m + k + ℓ) → ℝ) (f : Rn (m + k + ℓ) → Rn m) (D E : Set (Rn (m + k))) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn (m + k + ℓ)) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), 0 < k → NullMeasurableSet M μHE[m + k] → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight (m + k) M θ → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → InjOn ψ D → (∃ K, LipschitzOnWith K ψ D) → (∀ u ∈ D, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ D → (∀ u ∈ E, f (ψ u) = G u ∧ HasFDerivAt (f ∘ ψ) (fderiv ℝ G u) u) → ∀ B ⊆ ψ '' E ∩ M, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn (m + k + ℓ) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in B ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ x in B, φ x * ENNReal.ofReal (coareaJacobian (approxTangentPlane (m + k) M θ x) f x) ∂μHE[m + k] = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in B ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume
